Before stopping, review ONLY this turn's changes (run git diff for tracked files and check any new/untracked files) for correctness bugs and clear simplification/optimization wins. Apply low-risk fixes directly and briefly report anything riskier; keep it proportional to the change. Use the code-review or simplify skill if helpful, then stop." '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; fi; exit 0
